title: GRADUS: Discovering and Recovering Agent Lessons from the Environment's Latent Syllabus
abstract: arXiv:2610.27781v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training LLM agents for policy-constrained tool environments, such as an airline backend with booking, refund, and cancellation policies, requires tasks that exercise the environment's rules individually and in combination. Existing synthesis pipelines let a model propose tasks and retain only those it immediately solves, biasing training data toward easier behaviors. We introduce Gradus (Graded Rungs of Ascending Difficulty from an Underlying System), which decouples what a task should teach from the concrete task and solution used to teach it. Without seed tasks, Gradus treats a fixed environment as a latent syllabus, extracting guarded behavioral operators that capture how actions depend on current conditions and how their effects reshape subsequent decisions. translated_title: GRADUS：从环境的潜在教学大纲中发现并恢复智能体的经验课程
translated_abstract: 训练大语言模型智能体以应对受政策约束的工具环境（例如包含预订、退款和取消政策的航空后台系统），需要能够在单独及组合层面演练环境规则的任务。现有的任务合成流程让模型自行提出任务，并只保留它能立即解决的任务，这导致训练数据偏向较简单的行为。我们提出 Gradus（Graded Rungs of Ascending Difficulty from an Underlying System，即基于底层系统的难度递增阶梯），它将任务应当教授的内容与用于教授该内容的具体任务及解决方案解耦。在无需种子任务的情况下，Gradus 将固定的环境视为一个潜在的教学大纲，提取带有前置条件的行为算子，这些算子刻画了动作如何依赖于当前条件，以及其效果如何重塑后续决策。它将这些算子组合成难度不断提升的任务，同时利用语料库层面的反馈来针对缺失的结果组合进行补充。至关重要的是，Gradus 联合校准任务……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: Gradus 将固定的环境视为潜在教学大纲，自动提取行为算子并组合生成难度递增、覆盖缺失行为组合的训练任务，从而更好地训练受政策约束环境中的大语言模型智能体。
en_tdlr: GRADUS treats a fixed environment as a latent syllabus, extracting behavioral operators to compose increasingly demanding tasks that target missing outcome combinations, enabling better training of LLM agents in policy-constrained tool environments.
